blocks.content: Now that you know what you are building and why it matters, it is time to get your hands dirty with code.
You will focus on the basics:

items: Create the three main screens: start, play, and end.
Connect your CSS and JavaScript files.

blocks.content: Think of it like building a house. You start with the foundation and frame. Once that is solid, adding details becomes much easier.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
